identification.reported_issue: Attachments.fetch_attachment receives the attachment name from the download URL. A name such as ../outside.txt may read files outside the attachment root. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Attachments
  # Return the stored attachment body for a download request.
  def self.fetch_attachment(root, name)
    File.read(File.join(root, name))
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'attachments'

class AttachmentsTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_reads_stored_attachment
    Dir.mktmpdir do |dir|
      File.write(File.join(dir, 'a.txt'), 'hello')
      assert_equal 'hello', Attachments.fetch_attachment(dir, 'a.txt')
    end
  end
end
